title: Quenched Slovakian Lentils Soup
description: A jammy, aerated Slovakian lentil soup that blends ginger paste and coconut milk for a bright, adventurous flavor. Perfect for a wholesome lunch.
instructions: Rinse the lentils under cold water until the water runs clear.
In a bamboo steamer, heat the vegetable stock until it begins to simmer.
Add the rinsed lentils to the stock and cook for 15 minutes until they soften.
In a small bowl, whisk the coconut milk with ginger paste, cumin seeds, coriander powder, and turmeric powder.
Pour the coconut milk mixture into the steamer, stir gently, and add the diced tomato and bell pepper.
Continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the soup to become jammy.
Stir in the chopped spinach, cooking until just wilted, about 2 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice, cilantro, and a pinch of salt, then serve hot.
